scope: REPORT.md section IV: six additional bounded concerns

embedding.coverage: Hard call limits; allocation overflow; prefix bytes; token and UTF-8 truncation; fail-fast concurrency and error release; unchanged successful vectors; actual localhost HTTP download corruption/retry/single-flight

encoder.coverage: V2 tie ordering and input-order independence; cached/reference equality at density/counting boundaries; legacy algorithms retained

format_and_integrity.command: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target cargo test --locked --features local-embed-download,security --test encoder_versions --test ingest_encode --test embed_store --test format_golden --test committed_sidecars
format_and_integrity.coverage: Existing golden stores unchanged, V2 source reencoding and reopen, canonical journal parity, source-preserving ingest, and actual failed audit sync with durable create/delete/reopen

checked_encoding.coverage: Checked single/batch/triple/sequence/analogy encoding; one admission for eight sparse writes; budget failure does not mutate a prefix; exact stored vectors survive restart; legacy infallible encoding fails loudly

all_features_clippy.scope: Checked encoding and native Node/Python bindings

importers.command: PYTHONPATH=bindings/python/holographic-sdk HMS_SERVER_BIN=target/debug/hms-server uv run --no-project --offline --python 3.13 --with pytest --with httpx --with numpy==2.5.4 python -m pytest -q bindings/python/holographic-sdk/tests/importers/test_identity.py bindings/python/holographic-sdk/tests/importers/test_core.py
importers.server_binary_source: Merged baseline; importer changes run directly from this working tree
importers.coverage: Content-bound resume, collision/ownership/split cleanup, completed-rerun updates and explicit source-deletion retention

documentation.command: uv run --no-project --offline --python 3.13 --with-requirements docs/requirements.txt mkdocs build --strict --site-dir target/bounded-docs
documentation.limitation: Rustdoc is supplied separately by the CI documentation gate

pending: Native Node and Python synthetic-fixture report/limit checks
limits: No measured performance or RSS improvement, pretrained task quality, hardware power-loss guarantee or independent cryptographic/finite-precision DP certification is claimed.
Per-call budgets exclude caller-owned input storage, foreign-runtime object copies, retained results, separately loaded models and host transport/task queues.
Rust infallible encode_text and find_analogy wrappers now panic on model/resource errors; use their try_ counterparts. Durable writes and Node APIs use checked paths.
Typed committed outcomes and process-local HTTP replay do not supply a durable sidecar outbox, repair worker or exactly-once external delivery.
Imports do not create snapshot isolation across source pages or propagate general source deletions.
V1 remains the default and retains historical unstable-selection ties; V2 is opt-in and requires source reencoding into a new store.
